name: Rethban Caverns
summary: Rethban Caverns wind through the northwestern cliffs of the Redridge Mountains. Aggressive Redridge gnolls infest this extensive cave system, the only source of uncommon Rethban ore.

sections.title: A Gnoll Warren
sections.body: Deep in the northwestern mountains above Lake Everstill, Rethban Caverns shelter the local gnolls as a fortified redoubt. Their cunning leader, Ardo Dirtpaw, commands a pack that fiercely guards the twisting passages and chambers below. Wanderers who stray too close to the hillside entrance face attack.

sections.title: The Veins of Rethban
sections.body: Rethban ore is a distinct mineral found in these winding, dangerous tunnels and carried by the Dirtpaw pack. Blacksmiths and researchers in Lakeshire often send travelers into the caverns to recover samples of this rare mountain ore.

faq.answer: Rethban Caverns lie along the jagged bluffs in northwestern Redridge, north of the main road toward Lakeshire.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside Rethban Caverns?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls of the Dirtpaw clan dwell in the tunnels, led by their cunning chieftain, Ardo Dirtpaw.

faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the caverns?
faq.answer: Travelers and townsfolk from Lakeshire seek uncommon Rethban ore, a mineral vein deep in the caves and held by the gnolls who live there.

angles.text: Rethban Caverns yield Rethban ore, a mineral deposit the local gnoll tribes fiercely contest.
The aggressive gnoll pack entrenched in Rethban Caverns threatens travelers in northern Redridge, so Lakeshire's defenders must keep the bluffs secure.
